verdict.rationale: New Relic's APM agents add metadata to forwarded logs to provide 'logs in context', meaning log data appears in relevant places across the platform. Its log management is described as giving visibility alongside events, errors and traces for troubleshooting, so trace-to-log correlation is implied. However, the evidence never explicitly describes navigating from a specific trace span to its logs or to correlated metrics. Missing for 10: explicit span-to-logs drill-down documentation, any evidence of span-to-metrics correlation, a documented end-to-end request debugging workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration.
